messages:
ana (product): quick sync on billing page UX. Two contenders: 'global-toolbar' (big download + denom toggle in header) vs 'inline-ledger' (compact rows, per-row overflow download + inline denom chip). which should be org default? figma: https://figma.com/file/preview123
yoav (design): global-toolbar cleaner for org-level glance. inline-ledger feels denser and better for project pages. main worry: token denomination label gets noisy in compact rows.
mica (frontend): perf note: inline denom chips add listeners. Overflow-only per-row is cheap; render menu contents on click. virtualization required for orgs with 100s of rows.
priya (a11y): accessibility: toolbar toggle must have aria-pressed and persistent state. per-row overflow menu needs role=\"menu\" and proper focus management. tiny icon-only buttons should expand on focus to include text.
owen (eng): backend: if toolbar bulk download is primary, we need batch zip job endpoint and job status + throttling. event schema: billing.invoice.download {scope, count, job_id}.
jade (data): prototype metrics: when row-level download visible, click rate ~30%; toolbar-only ~9%. small sample but consistent. recommend A/B test not full flip.
ci-bot: lint: color-contrast warning on token chips in compact variant.
nana (product): typo — ana. proposal: hybrid default for org: global-toolbar (visible primary CTA + denom toggle) + lightweight per-row overflow (Download) for power users. project default = inline-ledger. run 2-week A/B where variant A=global-toolbar baseline, B=hybrid. metrics: downloads per active user, failed downloads, support starts, and initial paint ms. jade you own metrics, owen implement batch API, mica will do lazy menus, priya will run a11y pass.
yoav (design): will update frames with focus-expand for icon buttons and clearer token-label: change \"Tokens\" -> \"Compute tokens (est.)\" in tooltip.
ana (product): great. sync next Wed 9am. :white_check_mark:
